title: The Penance Wheel
text: A wheel taller than a man stands in the court's square, stained dark at the rim. The court ties a penitent to it, and anyone may spin it for luck. Today's penitent hangs upside down, weeping without sound, while the crowd waits to see who spins first.

options.label: Untie the penitent, whatever the court thinks of it.

outcomes.text: The crowd boos, then stops booing and reaches for knives. The penitent blesses you as you fight.

options.label: The Leader spins the wheel as the custom asks, taking the luck it offers.

outcomes.text: The luck is of a kind, and he screams with every turn of it. The crowd cheers each scream.

options.label: The sharpest watches the crowd instead, to see who enjoys it most.

outcomes.text: You learn who rules here, and who wants to.
